components.name: Two Faculty of Arts Minors

components.name: Bachelor Thesis in Literary Studies

components.name: Open Electives

alternatives.concept: Study literary form, theory and adaptation alongside rhetoric, stylistics, persuasion, media and the historical interpretation of culture, identity and power. Psycholinguistics supplies a direct language-processing strand, while qualitative inquiry supports empirical cultural research. The programme does not offer advanced Dutch proficiency, Dutch grammar, historical Dutch linguistics or a Dutch/Flemish literary-history sequence.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: The first programme is organised around literature, cultural interpretation and historical context, with rhetoric and media alongside it. The second makes language processing, cognition and public communication central, replacing eight literature/history/documentary courses with neurobiology, perception, developmental psychology, experimental methods, philosophy of mind and data analysis. Each programme therefore contains 60 EC not found in the other, above the 30-EC floor.

notes.text: Radboud Dutch Language and Culture integrates advanced Dutch, Dutch and Flemish literary history, Dutch linguistics, rhetoric and a discipline-specific thesis. UCR can study literature, rhetoric, media, cultural interpretation, Psycholinguistics and basic everyday Dutch, or concentrate on language, cognition and public communication. These are related-fields responses: UCR does not offer advanced academic Dutch, Dutch phonology and syntax, historical Dutch linguistics or a Dutch/Flemish literary-history sequence.
